trace.ref: Keep it consistent with the existing System page

interface.ui: Sign-in for the gate preview: GET /auth/preview (redirects to / with an owner session). System page: route /system, page title "System · Agents", h1 "System" (unchanged). NEW section: a card with heading (h2) "Project Capabilities" placed on /system after the existing status cards. Inside it, one list item (li) per active project, ordered by project name; each list item contains a heading (h3) whose text is the project name (preview: "Demo Project") and a description list (dl) of term/definition pairs (dt = label, dd = value) with exactly these labels in this order: "Language", "Framework", "Package manager", "Build", "Test", "Lint", "Type check", "Browser tests". Values: Language = the detected languages joined with ", "; Framework / Package manager = the detected value; Build / Test / Lint / Type check = the detected command; Browser tests = "Available" when browser tests were detected; any value that was not detected = "Not detected". Value text matches the recorded profile value case-insensitively (display capitalisation such as "TypeScript" or "Next.js" is allowed as long as the recorded value is contained case-insensitively); commands are shown exactly as recorded. A project with no detected profile shows the text "No capability profile detected yet." in its list item instead of the description list. Preview demo profile of "Demo Project" (slug "demo"): languages ["typescript"], framework "next", package manager "npm", build "npm run build", test "npm run test", lint "npm run lint", type check not detected (null), browser tests detected (true). Existing cards on /system keep their headings: "Backups", "Recent executor errors", "Administrative operations (audit log)"; status cards "Build" and "Executor jobs". Other pages unchanged: /decisions h1 "Decisions"; /projects/demo h1 "Demo Project"; the Command page / has NO h1 (unchanged) and is identified by its "Projects" panel heading (h2 "Projects") listing "Demo Project" with a "New intent" link to /projects/demo/new.

non_goals: Changing how capability profiles are detected (detection rules, which files are read, when a profile is refreshed) or what is stored in the database.
Triggering, refreshing or editing a capability profile from the UI; the section is read-only and adds no buttons or forms.
Showing capability profiles anywhere other than the System page (e.g. Command page, project page, task page) or exposing them in the API under /api/v0.
Requiring the other profile fields (commit, database, tooling, Dockerfile check stage, list of unknowns) to be shown; they may be shown but are not part of this task.
Listing deactivated projects; registering, editing or removing projects.
Changing the existing System page cards, tables, live refresh, sign-in, sessions or authorization.
Adding or changing headings on the Command page (/); in particular no h1 "Command" is added or required there.

scope.summary: The System page (/system) gets a new read-only section headed "Project Capabilities" that shows, for each configured (active) project, the capability profile Agents App has detected from that project's repository: the detected language, framework and package manager, and the available build, test, lint, type-check and browser-test capabilities (the detected command, or that the capability was not detected). A project for which no profile has been detected yet is still listed and says so. The section follows the look of the existing System page cards, and all existing System page content (status cards, Backups, Recent executor errors, Administrative operations audit log) keeps working unchanged. For black-box verification the gate preview's Demo Project carries a demonstration capability profile with the values stated in the interface. No other page changes; in particular the Command page (/) gets no new heading.

title: Project capabilities on the System page
